newsitem.title: YEMEN: Oman, Yemen to celebrate border demarcation.
newsitem.headline: Oman, Yemen to celebrate border demarcation.

text.p: Yemen and Oman will mark the demarcation of their border with a formal celebration this month, a senior Yemeni official said on Monday.
Officials from the two Arab states will exchange border demarcation certificates and maps at the event, to be held before Yemen's parliamentary elections on April 27, he said.

The two Arabian peninsula countries signed a border accord in October 1992, ending a 25-year dispute over the 308 km (180 miles) frontier. A year later, they opened their first border crossing after the border was surveyed and new maps printed.
